        if resp.status_code != 200:

        soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, 'xml')

        results = []
        for item in items[:limit]:
            title = item.title.text if item.title else ''
            link = item.link.text if item.link else ''
            desc = item.description.text if item.description else ''
            pubdate = item.pubDate.text if item.pubDate else ''
            results.append({'title': title, 'link': link, 'desc': desc, 'pubdate': pubdate})
        return results
    except Exception as e:

        return []

            # Remove script, style

                tag.decompose()
            text = soup.get_text()
            lines = [line.strip() for line in text.splitlines() if line.strip()]
            return ' '.join(lines[:200])  # limit
    except Exception as e:

    return ''

# Dedup and limit to first 30 queries for speed

all_articles = {}
for q in queries:
    print(f"Searching: {q}")
    results = search_bing_rss(q, limit=10)
    for r in results:
        if r['link'] not in all_articles:
            all_articles[r['link']] = r
    time.sleep(0.5)  # be polite

print(f"Total unique articles: {len(all_articles)}")

# Save to JSON for later processing

import asyncio
import aiohttp
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import json
import re

async def fetch_and_parse(session, url, lastmod):
    """Fetch article page, return filtered metadata if relevant"""
    try:
        async with session.get(url, timeout=10) as resp:
            if resp.status == 200:
                html = await resp.text()
                soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
                title_tag = soup.find('title')
                title = title_tag.text if title_tag else ''
                # Get meta description
                desc = ''
                meta_desc = soup.find('meta', attrs={'name': 'description'})
                if meta_desc:
                    desc = meta_desc.get('content', '')
                return {'url': url, 'title': title, 'desc': desc, 'lastmod': lastmod}
    except:
        pass
    return None

async def main():
    with open('/tmp/all_articles.json', 'r') as f:
        all_articles = json.load(f)
    print(f"Total articles to fetch: {len(all_articles)}")
    
    # Keywords for completion/project articles
    keywords = ['竣工', '投产', '通车', '启用', '完工', '建成', '试运行', '开通', '交付', '发电', '并网', '投用', '落成', '贯通']
    
    relevant = []
    sem = asyncio.Semaphore(50)  # 50 concurrent
    
    async def bounded_fetch(article):
        async with sem:
            result = await fetch_and_parse(None, article['url'], article.get('lastmod', ''))
            if result:
                combined = result['title'] + result['desc']
                for kw in keywords:
                    if kw in combined:
                        return result
            return None
    
    # Need to create session
    connector = aiohttp.TCPConnector(limit=50)
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession(connector=connector, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; Googlebot/2.1; +http://www.google.com/bot.html)'}) as session:
        # Bind session to fetch function
        async def fetch_with_session(article):
            async with sem:
                result = await fetch_and_parse(session, article['url'], article.get('lastmod', ''))
                if result:
                    combined = result['title'] + result['desc']
                    for kw in keywords:
                        if kw in combined:
                            return result
                return None
        
        tasks = [asyncio.create_task(fetch_with_session(a)) for a in all_articles]
        results = await asyncio.gather(*tasks, return_exceptions=True)
        for r in results:
            if isinstance(r, dict):
                relevant.append(r)
    
    print(f"Found {len(relevant)} completion-related articles")
    with open('/tmp/relevant.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump(relevant, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print("Saved to /tmp/relevant.json")

if __name__ == '__main__':
    asyncio.run(main())
